name: lakeside_hikers
text_prompt: Two hikers standing at the grassy edge of a lake under a cloudy sky, a woman with a backpack and a man in an orange shirt. Eye-level long take. Midway through the shot, the hikers turn their faces toward the viewer and raise a thumbs-up toward the camera with bright friendly smiles, brightly calling out 'Good!' in cheerful approval. These are the only people in the scene; the surroundings are open and calm. They hold a relaxed photo pose, bodies settled and steady, gesturing with their hands. Photoreal, natural lighting.
